production.note: US model years 2021-2024. Start: Audi of America, 16 Sep 2020: 'a trio of 2021 RS models are now on sale to customers in the U.S. - the highly anticipated RS 6 Avant, the RS 7, and the first RS-SUV, the RS Q8' (price table '2021 Audi RS Q8 | $114,500'). End year is provisional and rests on Kelley Blue Book (database): its 2024 RS Q8 page lists 'RS Q8 Sport Utility 4D', '591 HP' (kbb-rs-q8-2024), while its 2025 page lists only the 'RS Q8 Performance', '631 HP' (kbb-rs-q8-2025), a separate variant. Some databases (Edmunds, Cars.com) also carry a '2020' RS Q8 page, but Audi of America's release names the US car a 2021 model.

body.note: Audi: 'It combines the power of an RS model with the elegance of a premium coupe and flexibility of an SUV.'

displacementL.note: Audi: '4.0 liter V8'. 3,996 cc per audi.com's data for the same 4.0 TFSI in the 2024 updated RS Q8 ('Displacement in cc ... 3996', audi-rsq8-2024-audicom); Cars.com lists '4.0 L/244' for the 2021 US car (carscom-rs-q8-2021).

fuel.note: 48-volt mild hybrid, so Gasoline per the data guide: 'Its mild-hybrid system (MHEV) is based on a 48-volt main electrical system.'

powerHp.note: Audi AG rating converted: Quote: "441 kW (600 hp), 800 Nm (590.0 lb-ft) of torque between 2,200 and 4,500 rpm." 441 kW x 1.34102 = 591.4, so 591 hp. Two US spec databases print the same US figure: Cars.com 'SAE Net Horsepower @ RPM 591 @ 6000' (carscom-rs-q8-2021) and KBB 'Horsepower | 591 @ 6000 RPM' (kbb-rs-q8-2021). No Audi of America page stating the RS Q8's hp was found (the 2020 release gives 591 hp only for the RS 7).

weightLb.note: PROVISIONAL: spec databases. 2021 US RS Q8, single configuration. Cars.com quote: "Base Curb Weight 5,490 lbs". Kelley Blue Book (kbb-rs-q8-2021) agrees: "Curb Weight | 5490 pounds". Two databases agree; no Audi of America or major magazine figure was found. audi.com's EU unladen weight for the 2024 updated car (2,315 kg without driver) is a different market and model year and is not used.

provisionalNote: Weight rests on Cars.com and Kelley Blue Book (databases, both 5,490 lb); an Audi of America specification sheet or a major magazine's specification panel would replace it. The last US model year (2024) also rests on Kelley Blue Book; an Audi of America model-year release would replace it. Power is Audi AG's 441 kW converted (manufacturer) and matches the US databases' 591 hp; an Audi of America page giving 591 hp would confirm it.
